## `cidx cicd`

Usage: `cidx cicd [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

```text
CI/CD pipeline monitoring (remote mode only).

Monitor GitHub Actions and GitLab CI pipelines from the CLI.
```

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`github`](#cidx-cicd-github) | GitHub Actions workflow monitoring. |
| [`gitlab`](#cidx-cicd-gitlab) | GitLab CI pipeline monitoring. |

## `cidx cicd github`

Usage: `cidx cicd github [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

```text
GitHub Actions workflow monitoring.

Commands to list, inspect, and control GitHub Actions workflow runs.
```

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`cancel`](#cidx-cicd-github-cancel) | Cancel a running or queued GitHub Actions workflow run. |
| [`job-logs`](#cidx-cicd-github-job-logs) | Get complete logs for a specific GitHub Actions job. |
| [`list`](#cidx-cicd-github-list) | List GitHub Actions workflow runs for OWNER/REPO. |
| [`logs`](#cidx-cicd-github-logs) | Search logs for a GitHub Actions workflow run. |
| [`retry`](#cidx-cicd-github-retry) | Retry a failed GitHub Actions workflow run. |
| [`show`](#cidx-cicd-github-show) | Show details of a GitHub Actions workflow run. |

## `cidx cicd github cancel`
